description: This file defines functions and types related to cross-context messaging policies and decorations in a chat application, including enforcement of cross-channel policies, building message decorations, and applying markers.

methods.name: resolveContextGuardTarget
methods.description: Determines the target channel ID based on the action and parameters, used for cross-context message validation.

methods.name: normalizeTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a target string for a given channel, trimming or applying provider-specific normalization.

methods.name: isCrossContextTarget
methods.description: Checks if the target is different from the current channel, indicating a cross-context message.

methods.name: enforceCrossContextPolicy
methods.description: Enforces messaging policies to prevent unauthorized cross-channel communication based on configuration and context.

methods.name: buildCrossContextDecoration
methods.description: Constructs message decoration (prefix, suffix, components) for cross-context messages if applicable.

methods.name: shouldApplyCrossContextMarker
methods.description: Determines if a message action should have a cross-context marker applied.

methods.name: applyCrossContextDecoration
methods.description: Applies the decoration to a message, either as a prefix/suffix or via components.
